calculation.description: For each completed session, subtract the equal-weight cross-sectional intraday return from each instrument's close-to-open return, then reverse and sum the residual over the latest three completed sessions. The signal predicts next-session close-to-close return. Missing observations are excluded cross-sectionally.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (0.036805; ICIR 0.106192), 2023-2024 (0.035871; ICIR 0.100664), and 2025-2026 (0.023005; ICIR 0.064471). Recent regime ICIR is below the full-sample value, so monitor for drift.
